## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Chāmópódì shòujì jīng* (T573, *Kṣemavatī-vyākaraṇa-sūtra*) is a one-fascicle Mahāyāna prediction sūtra translated by Bodhiruci I 菩提流支 ([菩提流支](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E6%94%AF)) at the Northern Wèi 元魏 capital Luòyáng. The protagonist *Chāmópódì* 差摩婆帝 is a transcription of *Kṣemavatī*, the chief queen of King Bimbisāra, who receives a *vyākaraṇa* (prophecy) of future buddhahood. CANWWW gives Sanskrit *Kṣemavatīvyākaraṇa(sūtra)* and alternate title 差摩波帝受記經.

**Abstract**

A short *vyākaraṇa* sūtra centered on a royal woman, transmitted in the Northern Wèi-period translation cluster of Bodhiruci I (active in Luòyáng ca. 508–535). The bracket adopted here matches Bodhiruci's documented activity span from his arrival in the year of Yǒngpíng 1 (508) until the late Wèi period.
